description: Close the active Illustrator document. If the document has unsaved changes and save is omitted, the document is NOT closed and an error is returned — pass save: true to save, or save: false to explicitly discard the changes. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

save.description: true = save then close; false = close and DISCARD unsaved changes. Omit to close only when there are no unsaved changes

name: close_document
title: Close Document
